rows.text: Jetmir counts your creatures. With three, every creature you control gets +1/+0 and vigilance; with six, +2/+0 and trample as well; with nine, +3/+0 and double strike too. At nine, a 1/1 Goblin token is a 4/1 with double strike and trample — 8 damage — and ten of them are 80. Vigilance keeps your attackers untapped to block afterwards, so attack every turn.
And any infinite loop of hasty creatures with Jetmir out is an unlimited army of double strikers — the deck has several — see the combos.

Mana creatures count toward the thresholds, and so do tokens made at instant speed. Secure the Wastes or March of the Multitudes after blockers are declared can take you from six creatures to nine before damage. The bonuses also drop the moment you fall below a threshold, so don't trade creatures away mid-combat when you're sitting on exactly nine.

rows.name: Jetmir, Nexus of Revels
rows.text: four mana. Three creatures: +1/+0 and vigilance. Six: also +1/+0 and trample. Nine: also +1/+0 and double strike. Every creature you control, tokens included.

rows.name: Lightning Greaves
rows.text: shroud the turn Jetmir lands — the table knows what it does. Never equip it to Kiki-Jiki — shroud stops Zealous Conscripts or Restoration Angel from targeting Kiki.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Zealous Conscripts
rows.text: Kiki copies Conscripts, and the copy's enter trigger untaps Kiki — target Kiki itself. Repeat for as many hasty 3/3s as you want, the same turn Kiki lands (it has haste). With Jetmir out every copy is a double striker; Impact Tremors and General Kreat turn them into damage before they even attack. Never leave Lightning Greaves on Kiki: shroud stops the Conscripts copy targeting it.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Restoration Angel
rows.text: Kiki copies the Angel; the copy blinks Kiki, which comes back untapped with haste. Flash: start it in an opponent's end step and the copies last until the end of your next turn.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Village Bell-Ringer
rows.text: the copy untaps every creature you control, Kiki included. Flash, so this one works in an opponent's end step too.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Lightning Crafter + Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: Kiki copies the Crafter. The copy's champion trigger exiles Kiki; the hasty copy taps for 3 damage; sacrifice it to Goblin Bombardment; Kiki returns untapped — it has haste — and copies the Crafter again. Unlimited 3-damage shots, so this one kills on its own. The original Crafter must stay on the battlefield; when it enters you must exile another Goblin or Shaman (champion) or sacrifice it.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Thornbite Staff + Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: the Staff attaches itself to Kiki when Kiki enters after it (otherwise equip costs {4}). Kiki copies any nonlegendary creature, you sacrifice a creature to Goblin Bombardment, and the death untaps Kiki. Unlimited loops. This loop deals damage rather than building an army.

rows.name: Krenko, Mob Boss + Thornbite Staff + Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: equip the Staff to Krenko ({4} — he's a Warrior, so it won't attach itself). Krenko taps for a Goblin per Goblin; sacrifice one to Goblin Bombardment; the death untaps Krenko; tap again. The army doubles every lap. Win with Impact Tremors, General Kreat or a double-striking attack.

guide.title: Tutor lines — what to fetch, and when

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: when you already hold Zealous Conscripts, Restoration Angel, Village Bell-Ringer, Lightning Crafter or the Staff — Kiki is the piece that turns half a combo into a kill.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Goblin Recruiter
rows.text: when you're missing two or more pieces. Matron gets Recruiter; Recruiter stacks the rest on top of your library.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Krenko, Mob Boss
rows.text: when Thornbite Staff is already out, or when you simply need a board this turn.

rows.name: Goblin Matron -> Lightning Crafter
rows.text: when Kiki-Jiki is on the battlefield and you have a free outlet — the Crafter is the last piece.

rows.name: Imperial Recruiter -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: power 2, so the one non-Goblin tutor that still finds Kiki. It also gets Village Bell-Ringer or Goblin Recruiter.

rows.name: Eladamri's Call -> Zealous Conscripts
rows.text: instant speed, for the non-Goblin half that Matron can't find.

rows.name: Chord of Calling -> Restoration Angel
rows.text: with Kiki already out, Chord the Angel in at the end of an opponent's turn and go off right there. Convoke lets your army pay the generic part.

rows.name: Formidable Speaker -> Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: discard a spare card when it enters to find any creature — Kiki, or whichever partner you lack.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Goblin Ringleader + Muxus, Goblin Grandee
rows.text: choose a four-card hand refill or a six-creature deployment. The exact piles and draw sequencing are below; either payoff works without the commander.

guide.title: Goblin Recruiter setups — what to stack, top card first

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Goblin Ringleader
rows.text: TOP to BOTTOM: Goblin Ringleader; Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker; Lightning Crafter; Skirk Prospector; Goblin Warchief. Draw or otherwise reach Ringleader, then cast it: its entry trigger puts the next four selected Goblins into your hand. Those creatures still need to be cast; Ringleader does not deploy them. If Ringleader is already in hand, start the pile with the four targets instead.

rows.name: Goblin Recruiter -> Muxus, Goblin Grandee
rows.text: TOP to BOTTOM: Muxus, Goblin Grandee; Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker; Lightning Crafter; Skirk Prospector; Goblin Warchief; Goblin Ringleader; Krenko, Mob Boss. Reach and cast Muxus; all six following cards are Goblin creatures with mana value five or less, so its entry trigger puts them onto the battlefield. If Muxus is already in hand, omit it from the pile and reveal the six immediately.

rows.name: Goblin Ringleader
rows.text: Put these four cards immediately UNDER the six-card Muxus package: Goblin Matron; Siege-Gang Commander; Goblin Chieftain; Howlsquad Heavy. When Muxus deploys Ringleader, the entry trigger puts this backup package into your hand. Resolve Ringleader before any other draw triggers and before the original Lightning Crafter's champion trigger. Only stack cards still in your library; substitute useful Goblins for pieces already in hand or on the battlefield.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker + Lightning Crafter + Skirk Prospector
rows.text: The original Crafter champions the Recruiter that made the pile, or the Ringleader AFTER its refill resolves. Keep Kiki and Prospector on the battlefield. Tap Kiki to copy Crafter; the hasty copy champions Kiki, taps for 3 damage, then is sacrificed to Prospector for {R}. Kiki returns untapped with haste. Repeat for lethal damage and red mana. No combat or commander is required, but removal or effects that stop the entry triggers/activated abilities can interrupt it.

rows.name: Goblin Warchief
rows.text: Included on the Muxus board to give your other Goblins haste and reduce the generic cost of backup Goblin spells. Kiki and its copies already have haste; Warchief is for Krenko and the wider recovery plan.

Use the next natural draw to reach the payoff, or arrange for an existing draw engine to take exactly the intended cards. If Skullclamp will draw two, put an extra useful Goblin above the payoff so the four/six-card package stays intact.

rows.name: Guardian Project
rows.text: Order the Muxus entry trigger ABOVE Project's draw trigger so Muxus reveals its intended six first. When those creatures enter, put Ringleader's trigger above their Project draws so it gets the intended four. Mandatory draws also limit how many Kiki loops you can safely repeat; finish before your library empties.

Searches that shuffle undo the pile: use fetch lands and other tutors BEFORE Recruiter. Any extra draw, mill or exile also changes the positions; account for it before committing. Muxus only puts eligible Goblin CREATURES onto the battlefield: Goblin-typed instants/enchantments and Muxus itself are not hits. Recruiter does not put the payoff in your hand for free.

rows.name: Krenko, Mob Boss
rows.text: taps for a 1/1 per Goblin you control. Thanks to vigilance it can attack AND tap afterwards.

rows.name: Krenko, Tin Street Kingpin
rows.text: each attack puts a +1/+1 counter on it, then makes Goblins equal to its power — two the first time, three the next.

rows.name: Siege-Gang Commander
rows.text: four creatures from one card.

rows.name: Mogg War Marshal
rows.text: two creatures, and another when it dies.

rows.name: Legion Warboss
rows.text: a hasty Goblin each of your combats.

rows.name: Goblin Rabblemaster
rows.text: a hasty Goblin every combat. Your other Goblins must attack, which costs nothing with Jetmir's vigilance.

rows.name: Siege-Gang Lieutenant
rows.text: two hasty Goblins each of your combats while Jetmir is on the battlefield.

rows.name: Howlsquad Heavy
rows.text: a Goblin each of your combats, and haste for every other Goblin.

rows.name: General Kreat, the Boltbringer
rows.text: a Goblin when your Goblins attack, and 1 damage to each opponent per other creature that enters.

rows.name: Ainok Strike Leader
rows.text: whenever it or Jetmir attacks, a 1/1 Goblin attacking each opponent.

rows.name: Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker
rows.text: a hasty copy each turn — Siege-Gang Commander is four more creatures every turn.

rows.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker
rows.text: a Goblin that makes Treasure when it attacks, then a card filter, then Reflection of Kiki-Jiki — a copy maker that costs {1} each use and needs a turn before it can tap.

cards.name: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

rows.name: Secure the Wastes
rows.text: X 1/1s at instant speed — the cheapest way to jump to nine mid-combat.

rows.name: March of the Multitudes
rows.text: X lifelink 1/1s at instant speed, and convoke lets your creatures pay for it.

rows.name: Goblin Chieftain
rows.text: other Goblins +1/+1 and haste.

rows.text: Goblins cost one less and have haste.

rows.name: The Fire Crystal
rows.text: every creature you control has haste, and red spells cost one less.

rows.name: Rhythm of the Wild
rows.text: your creature spells can't be countered, and nontoken creatures enter with haste or a +1/+1 counter.

rows.name: Shared Animosity
rows.text: every attacking Goblin gets +1/+0 for each other attacking Goblin — and double strike hits with all of it twice.

rows.name: Warleader's Call
rows.text: your creatures get +1/+1, and every creature that enters deals 1 to each opponent.

rows.name: Beastmaster Ascension
rows.text: one counter per attacker; at seven your creatures get +5/+5. One attack turns it on for good.

rows.name: Akroma's Will
rows.text: with Jetmir out, both modes: flying and double strike, plus lifelink, indestructible and protection from every colour.

rows.name: Kessig Wolf Run
rows.text: pump one attacker and give it trample.

rows.name: Castle Embereth
rows.text: {1}{R}{R} and a tap: your creatures get +1/+0.

rows.name: Impact Tremors
rows.text: 1 to each opponent for every creature that enters.

rows.name: Goblin Bombardment
rows.text: sacrifice a creature for 1 damage anywhere. Careful not to drop below nine mid-combat.

rows.name: Skirk Prospector
rows.text: sacrifice a Goblin for {R}. A one-mana creature for Jetmir's thresholds, acceleration for Muxus, and the free outlet Recruiter can find for the Crafter combo. Preserve your creature count when winning through combat.

rows.name: Gaea's Cradle
rows.text: a green mana for every creature you control.

rows.name: Circle of Dreams Druid
rows.text: the same on a creature.

rows.name: Birds of Paradise
rows.text: a one-mana source of any colour.

rows.name: Llanowar Elves
rows.text: a one-mana green source.

rows.name: Elvish Mystic
rows.text: the same.

rows.name: Avacyn's Pilgrim
rows.text: a one-mana white source.

rows.text: a Forest dual onto the battlefield.

rows.name: Three Visits
rows.text: the same.

rows.name: Sol Ring
rows.text: the fastest start.

rows.name: Arcane Signet
rows.text: any of your three colours.

rows.name: Jeska's Will
rows.text: with Jetmir out, both halves: a red mana for each card in an opponent's hand, and the top three cards to play this turn.

rows.name: Three Tree City
rows.text: name Goblin: {2} and a tap make a mana for every Goblin you control.

rows.name: Cavern of Souls
rows.text: name Goblin: they can't be countered.

rows.text: equip it to a creature with 1 toughness and it dies: two cards for one mana. A lord that adds toughness keeps your tokens alive, so pick an X/1.

rows.text: a card whenever a nontoken creature with a new name enters.

rows.name: Tocasia's Welcome
rows.text: a card once a turn when a creature with mana value 3 or less enters — tokens count.

rows.text: taxes each opponent's first noncreature spell each turn or draws you a card.

rows.text: free with Jetmir out; your creatures become indestructible.

rows.text: phase out any of your nonland permanents; convoke lets your tokens pay.

rows.name: Swords to Plowshares

guide.title: What to keep in an opening hand

rows.text: Keep a mana creature and something that makes two bodies. Cast Jetmir on turn three or four with three creatures already out and your team attacks for real at once.
Attack every turn — vigilance means the army is still there to block.
Count before combat. Eight creatures and an instant token spell in hand is nine with double strike.
